architecture.name: ReducedPointNet2_SSG_XYZI_v1
architecture.input_transform: per-block XYZ centroid/max radius; log1p(max(intensity,0)); no fitted parameters
architecture.padding: not used; contexts shorter than128 unavailable
architecture.feature_propagation: upstream 3-neighbor internal feature interpolation, not identity or unsampled output assignment
architecture.normalization: all context XYZ; independent of labels; no training/test population fitting

loss: sum(global per-query weight * NLL) / (actual batch blocks * fixed512 capacity)
epoch_loss: sum global weighted NLL / sum training query weights
only_ablation: multiply local person/vehicle reference1/2 global training weights by2, globally mean-normalize; no confidence/noise/other loss change
stability_gate: all eight finite epoch losses, finite nonzero backward gradients and finite model parameters; no evaluation accuracy criterion
